verdict.rationale: Bruno lets teams write collection docs and 'publish as shareable HTML' and embed README buttons to open a shared workspace, giving a minimal form of API discovery, but there is no evidence of an actual internal catalog/portal with search, cataloging across teams, or governance for API consumption. missing for 10: a dedicated catalog/portal product, multi-API discovery/search UI, and any documentation of team-wide publishing/governance beyond per-collection HTML docs.
